candidates.change_summary: Change the assignment of unlockTime to always set to the provided _unlockTime (no max with block.timestamp), allowing future earlier unlocks or past unlock times.
Remove the addition to the holder's balance so that Put no longer increases Acc[msg.sender].balance (only sets unlockTime and logs).
Change order: set unlockTime before updating balance, which can interact with reentrancy or modifiers affecting observable state ordering.
Modify nonReentrant_ to omit unlocking after function body (locked_ stays true), preventing subsequent Put calls and changing observable behavior.
Modify the nonReentrant_ modifier to NOT reset the lock after function execution (remove the final unlocked assignment), causing reentrancy guard to stay locked after first use.
Change the external call in Collect to use transfer instead of low-level call, which throws on failures and sends 2300 gas only (affects success/failure and reentrancy surface).
Move the balance decrement to before the external call, so the contract state is updated prior to sending funds.
